purpose: Create defensible non-event controls without teaching the model reporting or camera-availability bias.
admission_rules: A clean negative requires known observation effort during the target window.
No report is weak evidence and is never automatically a clean negative.
Camera negatives apply only to the visible area and interval; stale/frozen/dark/obstructed footage is UNKNOWN.
Public-camera absence cannot become a predictor of Jubilee absence.
Human/social observation availability is preserved as detectability metadata, not silently folded into the physical target.
Matched controls should be sampled from the same shoreline cell, season, predawn clock window, tide/current phase and comparable sensing/reporting availability as positive events.
Adjacent windows from one night are clustered as one episode for validation independence.

prospective_capture.strategy: On every dawn sensing cycle, log whether each cell was actually observable even when no Jubilee evidence appears.
prospective_capture.benefit: Builds the missing negative/control denominator prospectively with much stronger detectability information than retrospective no-report days.

validation_use: Controls are eligible only after observation-effort audit and episode clustering; final split design follows model_validation_contract.json.
